description: Potentiel d'intensité et de propagation des feux de forêt is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. La Direction de la protection des forêts du ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts a produit une couche matricielle représentant le potentiel d’intensité et de propagation des feux de forêt sur le territoire québécois. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Its tags are Combustible, Feux de forêt, Intensité, Risque de feu. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOTIFF, PDF. The portal shows 2025-07-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
